extracted.name: Hawaii Five-O
extracted.description: This is a dangerously delicious beverage with vanilla vodka, Grand Marnier, pineapple, and lime juice. “Book ‘em, Danno.”
ingredient_lines: 1 cup ice cubes, or as needed
1 fluid ounce brandy-based orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)
instruction_lines: Fill a glass with ice. Pour vodka and Grand Marnier over ice. Pour in pineapple juice, then squeeze lime wedge on top.
